summary.text: Your employer pays first. Then MediShield Life pays the remaining amount, subject to your claim limits, deductible, and co-insurance.

details.heading: Remaining payment order
details.body: After MediShield Life, MediSave pays next, followed by cash.

steps.name: Employer pays
steps.text: Let your employer, private insurance, or other third-party payer pay first.

steps.name: MediShield Life pays
steps.text: Then MediShield Life or your Integrated Shield Plan pays for the portion of the bill that is not covered.
